positions.title: Military Police Officer
positions.description:
• Responsible for maintaining base and building security while managing personnel access
• Conducts law enforcement operations and patrols to ensure the safety of base inhabitants, collect intelligence, and to maintain the security of the area
• Trains for the capture and handling of high value targets in a combat scenario
• Completes paperwork in order to maintain a level of accountability and organization 
• Operates Humvee transports to and from base locations

positions.title: Charter Boat Captain
positions.description:
• Responsible for the navigation and safe transport of passengers for the duration of the cruises
• Entertain guests with historic and current information on Lake Minnetonka
• Maintain the condition of boats by cleaning and stocking prior to, and after cruises
• Managed the remodel of a large charter boat

company.name: Al & Alma's Supper Club and Charter Cruises

honors.title: Distinguished Honor Graduate
honors.description:
• Received recognition for the highest scores on written and practical exams while training as a Military Police Officer in the Military Police Basic Course
 • Finished top in class, resulting in a meritorious promotion
honors.issuer: Issued by United States Marine Corps · Apr 2016
